literal_meaning: মন খুলে কথা বলা (mind opening to speak)
figurative_meaning_en: To speak one's mind openly and honestly without reservation
similar_in_english: wear one's heart on one's sleeve
example_sentences_in_bangla: তুমি মন খুলে বলো, কী হয়েছে তোমার সাথে?
বন্ধুর সামনে মন খুলে কথা বললে মন হালকা হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: Open up and tell me what's wrong with you.
Speaking openly to a friend lightens the heart.
note: This idiom emphasizes emotional relief through honest communication, common in Bengali interpersonal dynamics.
